items.title: 2 Reasons PYPL is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead

items.title: How PayPal and Venmo Tuition Integrations Could Shape PayPal Holdings’ (PYPL) Commerce-Platform Ambitions
items.summary: In August 2026, PayPal Holdings announced that PayPal and Venmo can now be used to pay tuition and fees at U.S. colleges and universities through new integrations with Illumia, Nelnet Campus Commerce, and TouchNet, with services already live at institutions such as Bellarmine University, Butler University, Kansas State University, Michigan State University, and Texas Tech University. This move extends PayPal and Venmo from everyday spending into high-value, recurring tuition payments,...

items.title: Stripe beefs up AI as it encroaches on banking
items.summary: The payments company has acquired artificial intelligence firm OpenRouter in a deal that comes as banks consider strategies for large language models and Stripe is rumored to be in talks to buy PayPal.
